     1→# CLAUDE.md
     2→
     3→This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
     4→
     5→## Overview
     6→
     7→Lexical-based rich editor ecosystem. Modular packages: core editor, UI primitives, content renderers, plugins, extensions, and integration bundles.
     8→
     9→**Build**: Vite 7 + Vanilla Extract CSS-in-TS. ESM only (`.mjs`). TypeScript 5.9. Lexical 0.41.
    10→
    11→## Terminology: Static / Edit Split
    12→
    13→The editor ecosystem splits both **nodes** and **renderers** into static (read-only) and edit (editor-only) variants for bundle optimization.
    14→
    15→### Four Concepts
    16→
    17→| Term | Layer | Purpose | Example |
    18→|------|-------|---------|---------|
    19→| **Static Node** | Lexical node class | Deserialize JSON + `decorate()` returns `RendererWrapper`. No edit UI imports. | `CodeBlockNode`, `AlertQuoteNode` |
    20→| **Edit Node** | Lexical node class | Extends static node, overrides `decorate()` to use edit decorator with heavy deps (Popover, NestedComposer, etc.) | `CodeBlockEditNode`, `AlertQuoteEditNode` |
    21→| **Static Renderer** | React component | Display-only rendering. No `@haklex/rich-editor-ui` or `lucide-react` imports. | `AlertRenderer`, `MermaidRenderer` |
    22→| **Edit Renderer** | React component | Adds edit UI (DropdownMenu, Popover, presentDialog). Imports `@haklex/rich-editor-ui`. | `AlertEditRenderer`, `MermaidEditRenderer` |
    23→
    24→### Bundle Optimization Strategy
    25→
    26→```
    27→RichRenderer (read-only display)          RichEditor (full editing)
    28→├── Static Nodes (config.ts)              ├── Edit Nodes (config-edit.ts)
    29→├── Static Renderers                      ├── Edit Renderers
    30→│   (enhancedRendererConfig)              │   (enhancedEditRendererConfig)
    31→└── Zero edit UI deps                     └── Full edit UI deps
    32→```
    33→
    34→**Key principle**: `RichRenderer` entry imports only static nodes + static renderers, so bundlers tree-shake all edit UI deps (`@haklex/rich-editor-ui`, `lucide-react`, `LexicalNestedComposer`). `RichEditor` entry imports edit nodes + edit renderers that bring in these deps.
    35→
    36→**Split criteria**: Only split when the edit path introduces heavy imports absent from the static path. If edit logic is just a boolean prop with no extra imports (e.g. CodeBlock's `editable`), no split needed.
    37→

    43→| `@haklex/rich-editor` `src/config-edit.ts` | `customEditNodes` / `allEditNodes` (edit variants) | `RichEditor` |
    44→| `@haklex/rich-renderers` `src/config.ts` | `enhancedRendererConfig` (11 static renderers) | `ShiroRenderer` |
    45→| `@haklex/rich-renderers-edit` `src/config.ts` | `enhancedEditRendererConfig` (12 edit renderers) | `ShiroEditor` |

    95→## Foundation Packages
    96→
    97→### @haklex/rich-style-token
    98→
    99→Centralized theme tokens and CSS variables. Provides `createThemeStyle()`, variant presets (`articleTheme`, `noteTheme`, `commentTheme`), color constants (`darkColors`, `lightArticleColors`), layout constants, and `PortalThemeProvider` for shadow DOM theming. Used by nearly all packages.
   100→
   101→### @haklex/rich-headless
   102→
   103→Server-side Lexical node registry with zero React dependency. Exports `allHeadlessNodes` (20 node classes for JSON parsing), `allHeadlessTransformers`, and `$toMarkdown()`. Two entry points: `./` (nodes) and `./transformers` (markdown conversion).
   104→
   105→### @haklex/cm-editor
   106→
   107→Shared CodeMirror 6 utilities: `baseTheme`, `getThemeExtensions()`, `loadLanguageExtension()`. Used by `rich-ext-code-snippet` and `rich-renderer-codeblock` for code editing.
   108→
   109→## Core: @haklex/rich-editor
   110→
   111→Four entry points: `./` (all), `./editor` (RichEditor), `./static` (RichRenderer), `./styles` (CSS variables only).
   112→
   113→### Directory Layout
   114→
   115→- `src/nodes/` — 16 custom `DecoratorNode` types (Spoiler, Mention, KaTeXInline, KaTeXBlock, Image, AlertQuote, CodeBlock, Footnote, FootnoteSection, Video, LinkCard, Details, GridContainer, Banner, Mermaid, Ruby) + 5 edit variants (AlertQuoteEdit, BannerEdit, CodeBlockEdit, FootnoteSectionEdit, GridEdit)
   116→- `src/plugins/` — 18 Lexical plugins (Alert, AutoFocus, AutoLink, BlockExit, BlockId, DragDrop, EditorRef, Footnote, HorizontalRule, Image, ImageUpload, KaTeX, MarkdownShortcuts, Mermaid, OnChange, SubmitShortcut)
   117→- `src/styles/` — Vanilla Extract: 3 variants × 2 color schemes = 6 theme classes
   118→- `src/transformers/` — 14 Markdown shortcut transformers (alert `>[!NOTE]`, KaTeX `$$`, mention `@`, spoiler `||`, footnote `[^1]`, ruby, container, grid, quote, superscript/subscript, insert, rich-blocks, code-block)
   119→- `src/context/` — 5 contexts: `ColorSchemeContext` (light/dark), `RendererConfigContext` (custom renderer injection), `ImageUploadContext` (upload function injection), `FootnoteDefinitionsContext`, `NestedContentRendererContext`
   120→- `src/components/renderers/` — built-in default renderers (Alert, Banner, CodeBlock, Footnote, FootnoteSection, Grid, Image, KaTeX, LinkCard, Mention, Mermaid, Ruby, Video) + static decorators (Alert, Banner, Grid)
   121→- `src/components/decorators/` — edit decorators (Alert, Banner, CodeBlock, Grid)
   122→
   123→**Context Provider value stability**: Never pass object literals as context provider `value`. Primitives (string, function) can be passed directly (e.g. `ColorSchemeContext`, `ImageUploadContext`). Objects must be wrapped in `useMemo` (e.g. `RendererConfigContext`).
   124→
   125→### Custom Node Pattern
   126→
   127→All custom content nodes extend `DecoratorNode<ReactElement>`:
   128→
   129→```typescript
   130→class FooNode extends DecoratorNode<ReactElement> {
   131→  static importJSON(serialized) / exportJSON()
   132→  decorate() → <RendererWrapper type="Foo" props={...} />
   133→}
   134→export function $createFooNode(payload): FooNode
   135→export function $isFooNode(node): node is FooNode
   136→```
   137→
   138→`RendererWrapper` delegates to custom renderer (via `RendererConfig`) or falls back to built-in default.
   139→
   140→### Node: Edit / Render Split
   141→
   142→Nodes with heavy edit UI are split into two classes for tree-shaking:
   143→
   144→| Base Node (render-only) | Edit Node (editor-only) | Edit Dependency |
   145→|------------------------|------------------------|-----------------|
   146→| `AlertQuoteNode` | `AlertQuoteEditNode` | `AlertEditDecorator` + LexicalNestedComposer |
   147→| `BannerNode` | `BannerEditNode` | `BannerEditDecorator` + LexicalNestedComposer |
   148→| `CodeBlockNode` | `CodeBlockEditNode` | `CodeBlockEditDecorator` |
   149→| `FootnoteSectionNode` | `FootnoteSectionEditNode` | `FootnoteSectionEditRenderer` |
   150→| `GridContainerNode` | `GridEditNode` | `GridEditDecorator` |
   151→| `KaTeXBlockNode` | `KaTeXBlockEditNode`* | `KaTeXEditDecorator` + Popover |
   152→| `KaTeXInlineNode` | `KaTeXInlineEditNode`* | `KaTeXEditDecorator` + Popover |
   153→
   154→*KaTeX edit nodes live in `@haklex/rich-renderer-katex`, not in `rich-editor`.
   155→
   156→**Base node** `decorate()` returns `RendererWrapper` (or lightweight read-only decorator). No edit UI imports.
   157→
   158→**Edit node** extends base node, overrides `clone()` / `importJSON()` / `decorate()` to use the full edit decorator with heavy deps.
   159→
   160→Config files:
   161→- `src/config.ts` — `customNodes` / `allNodes` (render-only, used by `RichRenderer`)
   162→- `src/config-edit.ts` — `customEditNodes` / `allEditNodes` (edit nodes, used by `RichEditor`)
   163→
   164→**Adding a new node with edit UI**: Create base node with `RendererWrapper` in `decorate()`, then create `FooEditNode extends FooNode` overriding `decorate()` with edit decorator. Register base in `config.ts`, edit in `config-edit.ts`.
   165→
   166→### Plugin Pattern
   167→
   168→```typescript
   169→export const INSERT_FOO_COMMAND = createCommand<Payload>('INSERT_FOO_COMMAND')
   170→export function FooPlugin() {
   171→  const [editor] = useLexicalComposerContext()
   172→  useEffect(() => editor.registerCommand(INSERT_FOO_COMMAND, handler, COMMAND_PRIORITY_EDITOR), [editor])
   173→  return null
   174→}
   175→```
   176→
   177→## External Plugin Packages
   178→
   179→Plugins extracted into separate packages for independent versioning and tree-shaking:
   180→
   181→| Package | Key Export | Purpose |
   182→|---------|-----------|---------|
   183→| `@haklex/rich-plugin-block-handle` | `BlockHandlePlugin` | Block add button + context menu |
   184→| `@haklex/rich-plugin-floating-toolbar` | `FloatingToolbarPlugin` | Text formatting floating toolbar |
   185→| `@haklex/rich-plugin-link-edit` | `FloatingLinkEditorPlugin` | Inline link editing popover |
   186→| `@haklex/rich-plugin-mention` | `MentionMenuPlugin` | @ mention typeahead with platform selection |
   187→| `@haklex/rich-plugin-slash-menu` | `SlashMenuPlugin` | Typeahead slash commands for block insertion |
   188→| `@haklex/rich-plugin-table` | `TableCellResizerPlugin`, `TableRowColumnHandlesPlugin` | Table cell resizing + row/column handles |
   189→| `@haklex/rich-plugin-toolbar` | `ToolbarPlugin` | Top toolbar with formatting buttons, dropdowns, separators |
   190→
   191→All plugin packages depend on `@haklex/rich-style-token` for theming and export `./style.css`.
   192→
   193→## Extension Packages
   194→
   195→Extensions add complete features (nodes + renderers + plugins) with heavy isolated dependencies:
   196→
   197→| Package | Purpose | Key Deps |
   198→|---------|---------|----------|
   199→| `@haklex/rich-ext-code-snippet` | Multi-file code snippet with drag-reorder | `@haklex/cm-editor`, `@dnd-kit/*`, `shiki` |
   200→| `@haklex/rich-ext-embed` | URL embeds (Twitter, YouTube, Bilibili, Codesandbox, Gist, GitHub) | `react-tweet`, `lucide-react` |
   201→| `@haklex/rich-ext-excalidraw` | Excalidraw whiteboard (scene JSON + diff via jsondiffpatch) | `@excalidraw/excalidraw`, `jsondiffpatch` |
   202→| `@haklex/rich-ext-gallery` | Image gallery with drag-reorder and lightbox | `@dnd-kit/*`, `react-photo-view`, `thumbhash` |
   203→
   204→Extensions with static/edit split export dual entries: `./` (edit) and `./static` (render-only).
   205→
   206→## Variant System
   207→
   208→Controlled by `variant` prop + `ColorSchemeContext`. Theme CSS variables in `@haklex/rich-style-token` via `createThemeStyle()`.
   209→
   210→| Variant | Font | Size | Line-height | Max-width | Use case |
   211→|---------|------|------|-------------|-----------|----------|
   212→| article | system sans-serif | 16px | 1.75 | 65ch | Blog posts |
   213→| note | CJK serif (Noto Serif CJK SC) | 16px | 1.8 | 65ch | Personal notes |
   214→| comment | system sans-serif | 14px | 1.5 | none | Inline comments |
   215→
   216→## Renderer Config (Custom Renderer Injection)
   217→
   218→```typescript
   219→interface RendererConfig {
   220→  Alert?, Banner?, CodeBlock?, CodeSnippet?, Component?, Footnote?,
   221→  Gallery?, Image?, KaTeX?, LinkCard?, Mermaid?, Mention?,
   222→  Ruby?, Tabs?, Video?
   223→}
   224→<RichEditor rendererConfig={...} />
   225→<RichRenderer rendererConfig={...} />
   226→```
   227→
   228→## Individual Renderer Packages
   229→
   230→`@haklex/rich-renderer-*` packages provide feature-specific renderers with heavy dependencies isolated:
   231→- `alert` — GitHub-style alerts (info/warning/tip/caution/important)
   232→- `banner` — Colored banner container with nested content
   233→- `codeblock` — Shiki syntax highlighting
   234→- `image` — Blurhash/thumbhash, captions, accent colors
   235→- `katex` — KaTeX math equations (edit nodes only: `KaTeXBlockEditNode`, `KaTeXInlineEditNode`)
   236→- `linkcard` — Link preview cards
   237→- `mention` — Social platform mention badges
   238→- `mermaid` — Mermaid diagram rendering
   239→- `ruby` — Ruby annotation (furigana for Japanese text)
   240→- `video` — Responsive video players
   241→
   242→`@haklex/rich-renderers` aggregates all, with sub-path exports: `./codeblock`, `./mermaid`, etc.
   243→
   244→### Renderer: Edit / Static Split
   245→
   246→Renderer components with edit-only heavy deps are split into static and edit variants:
   247→
   248→| Package | Static (display-only) | Edit (with edit UI) | Edit Dependency |
   249→|---------|----------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
   250→| `rich-renderer-alert` | `AlertRenderer` | `AlertEditRenderer` | DropdownMenu (`@haklex/rich-editor-ui`) |
   251→| `rich-renderer-banner` | `BannerRenderer` | `BannerEditRenderer` | DropdownMenu + Popover (`@haklex/rich-editor-ui`) |
   252→| `rich-renderer-codeblock` | `CodeBlockRenderer` | `CodeBlockEditRenderer` | CodeMirror edit overlay |
   253→| `rich-renderer-image` | `ImageRenderer` | `ImageEditRenderer` | Upload/edit UI |
   254→| `rich-renderer-mention` | `MentionRenderer` | `MentionEditRenderer` | Popover (`@haklex/rich-editor-ui`) + lucide-react |
   255→| `rich-renderer-mermaid` | `MermaidRenderer` | `MermaidEditRenderer` | presentDialog (`@haklex/rich-editor-ui`) |
   256→| `rich-renderer-ruby` | `RubyRenderer` | `RubyEditRenderer` | Edit markup UI |
   257→| `rich-renderer-video` | `VideoRenderer` | `VideoEditRenderer` | Edit URL UI |
   258→| `rich-ext-code-snippet` | `CodeSnippetRenderer` | `CodeSnippetEditRenderer` | CodeMirror + @dnd-kit |
   259→| `rich-ext-excalidraw` | `ExcalidrawRenderer` | `ExcalidrawEditRenderer` | @excalidraw/excalidraw |
   260→| `rich-ext-gallery` | `GalleryRenderer` | `GalleryEditRenderer` | @dnd-kit + upload UI |
   261→
   262→Aggregator packages:
   263→- `@haklex/rich-renderers` — static-only. `enhancedRendererConfig` (`src/config.ts`), for `RichRenderer`. No edit deps.
   264→- `@haklex/rich-renderers-edit` — edit-only. `enhancedEditRendererConfig` (`src/config.ts`), for `RichEditor`. Spreads `enhancedRendererConfig` and overrides with edit variants. Also re-exports `FootnoteRenderer`.
   265→
   266→**Split criteria**: Only split when the edit path imports heavy deps (`@haklex/rich-editor-ui` components, `lucide-react` icons) absent from the static path. If edit logic is just a boolean flag with no extra imports, splitting adds complexity with no bundle benefit.
   267→
   268→**Adding a new renderer with edit UI**: Create `FooRenderer` (static) and `FooEditRenderer` (edit) in the same package. Export static from `./static` entry, edit from `./` entry. Add static to `enhancedRendererConfig` in `@haklex/rich-renderers`, edit to `enhancedEditRendererConfig` in `@haklex/rich-renderers-edit`.
   269→
   270→## Integration: @haklex/rich-kit-shiro
   271→
   272→Production bundle for the web app. Combines core + all renderers + all plugins + extensions.
   273→
   274→```typescript
   275→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/style.css'
   276→import { RichEditor } from '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/editor'       // → enhancedEditRendererConfig
   277→import { RichRenderer } from '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/renderer'   // → enhancedRendererConfig
   278→
   279→// Additional entry points:
   280→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/editor-core'     // core editor without renderers
   281→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/excalidraw'      // Excalidraw extension
   282→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/markdown'        // markdown conversion utilities
   283→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/nodes'           // all node classes
   284→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/plugins'         // all plugins
   285→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/renderers'       // static renderer config
   286→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/renderers-edit'  // edit renderer config
   287→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/style'           // style utilities
   288→```
   289→
   290→`ShiroEditor` uses `enhancedEditRendererConfig` (edit renderers). `ShiroRenderer` uses `enhancedRendererConfig` (static renderers). This ensures the renderer entry tree-shakes all edit UI deps (DropdownMenu, Popover, presentDialog, lucide-react edit icons).
   291→
   292→## Diff Viewer (@haklex/rich-diff)
   293→
   294→```typescript
   295→<RichDiff oldValue={...} newValue={...} variant="article" />
   296→```
   297→
   298→Compares two `SerializedEditorState` at node level. Side-by-side layout with insert/delete highlighting.
   299→
   300→## Build Configuration
   301→
   302→Shared Vite config factory in `haklex/vite.shared.ts` (`createViteConfig()`). Each package's `vite.config.ts` calls it with package-specific options (entry points, vanillaExtract toggle).
   303→
   304→- Auto-externalizes all `dependencies` + `peerDependencies` from each package's `package.json`
   305→- Vanilla Extract plugin for CSS-in-TS → static CSS (zero runtime)
   306→- Output: ESM `.mjs` + `.d.ts` declarations (via `vite-plugin-dts`)
   307→- Target: ES2020, no minification for JS, CSS minified
   308→
   309→## Styling
   310→
   311→Vanilla Extract (`*.css.ts` files) throughout. No Tailwind in editor packages. Theme contract defines CSS variables for colors, spacing, typography, and border-radius. Each variant+colorScheme combination produces a class name applied to the editor root.
   312→
   313→### Neutral colors
   314→
   315→Use a **neutral** (gray) color palette for secondary/muted text, borders, section labels, and descriptions—e.g. `#737373` / `#a3a3a3` (Tailwind neutral-500/400). Avoid tinted grays (slate, zinc, blue-gray) unless a design explicitly requires them. This keeps UI elements like slash menu sections and descriptions hue-neutral.
   316→

    19→| **Static Node** | Lexical node class | Deserialize JSON + `decorate()` returns `RendererWrapper`. No edit UI imports. | `CodeBlockNode`, `AlertQuoteNode` |
    20→| **Edit Node** | Lexical node class | Extends static node, overrides `decorate()` to use edit decorator with heavy deps (Popover, NestedComposer, etc.) | `CodeBlockEditNode`, `AlertQuoteEditNode` |
    21→| **Static Renderer** | React component | Display-only rendering. No `@haklex/rich-editor-ui` or `lucide-react` imports. | `AlertRenderer`, `MermaidRenderer` |
    22→| **Edit Renderer** | React component | Adds edit UI (DropdownMenu, Popover, presentDialog). Imports `@haklex/rich-editor-ui`. | `AlertEditRenderer`, `MermaidEditRenderer` |
    23→
    24→### Bundle Optimization Strategy
    25→
    26→```
    27→RichRenderer (read-only display)          RichEditor (full editing)
    28→├── Static Nodes (config.ts)              ├── Edit Nodes (config-edit.ts)
    29→├── Static Renderers                      ├── Edit Renderers
    30→│   (enhancedRendererConfig)              │   (enhancedEditRendererConfig)
    31→└── Zero edit UI deps                     └── Full edit UI deps
    32→```
    33→
    34→**Key principle**: `RichRenderer` entry imports only static nodes + static renderers, so bundlers tree-shake all edit UI deps (`@haklex/rich-editor-ui`, `lucide-react`, `LexicalNestedComposer`). `RichEditor` entry imports edit nodes + edit renderers that bring in these deps.
    35→
    36→**Split criteria**: Only split when the edit path introduces heavy imports absent from the static path. If edit logic is just a boolean prop with no extra imports (e.g. CodeBlock's `editable`), no split needed.
    37→
    38→### Registration
    39→
    40→| Config file | Contains | Used by |
    41→|-------------|----------|---------|
    42→| `@haklex/rich-editor` `src/config.ts` | `customNodes` / `allNodes` (16 static nodes) | `RichRenderer` |
    43→| `@haklex/rich-editor` `src/config-edit.ts` | `customEditNodes` / `allEditNodes` (edit variants) | `RichEditor` |
    44→| `@haklex/rich-renderers` `src/config.ts` | `enhancedRendererConfig` (11 static renderers) | `ShiroRenderer` |
    45→| `@haklex/rich-renderers-edit` `src/config.ts` | `enhancedEditRendererConfig` (12 edit renderers) | `ShiroEditor` |
    46→
    47→## Package Dependency Graph
    48→
    49→```
    50→@haklex/rich-kit-shiro (integration bundle for web app)
    51→├── @haklex/rich-editor (core: editor + renderer + nodes + plugins + styles)
    52→│   ├── @haklex/rich-editor-ui (headless Dialog, Dropdown, Popover via @base-ui/react)
    53→│   ├── @haklex/rich-headless (server-side Lexical node registry, zero React)
    54→│   └── @haklex/rich-style-token (theme tokens, CSS variables, variant presets)
    55→├── @haklex/rich-static-renderer (headless SSR engine, RichRenderer component)
    56→├── @haklex/rich-renderers (static-only renderer aggregator)

    78→## Commands
    79→
    80→```bash

    83→pnpm --filter @haklex/rich-static-renderer build

    94→
    95→## Foundation Packages
    96→
    97→### @haklex/rich-style-token
    98→
    99→Centralized theme tokens and CSS variables. Provides `createThemeStyle()`, variant presets (`articleTheme`, `noteTheme`, `commentTheme`), color constants (`darkColors`, `lightArticleColors`), layout constants, and `PortalThemeProvider` for shadow DOM theming. Used by nearly all packages.
   100→
   101→### @haklex/rich-headless
   102→
   103→Server-side Lexical node registry with zero React dependency. Exports `allHeadlessNodes` (20 node classes for JSON parsing), `allHeadlessTransformers`, and `$toMarkdown()`. Two entry points: `./` (nodes) and `./transformers` (markdown conversion).
   104→
   105→### @haklex/cm-editor
   106→
   107→Shared CodeMirror 6 utilities: `baseTheme`, `getThemeExtensions()`, `loadLanguageExtension()`. Used by `rich-ext-code-snippet` and `rich-renderer-codeblock` for code editing.
   108→
   109→## Core: @haklex/rich-editor
   110→
   111→Four entry points: `./` (all), `./editor` (RichEditor), `./static` (RichRenderer), `./styles` (CSS variables only).
   112→
   113→### Directory Layout
   114→
   115→- `src/nodes/` — 16 custom `DecoratorNode` types (Spoiler, Mention, KaTeXInline, KaTeXBlock, Image, AlertQuote, CodeBlock, Footnote, FootnoteSection, Video, LinkCard, Details, GridContainer, Banner, Mermaid, Ruby) + 5 edit variants (AlertQuoteEdit, BannerEdit, CodeBlockEdit, FootnoteSectionEdit, GridEdit)
   116→- `src/plugins/` — 18 Lexical plugins (Alert, AutoFocus, AutoLink, BlockExit, BlockId, DragDrop, EditorRef, Footnote, HorizontalRule, Image, ImageUpload, KaTeX, MarkdownShortcuts, Mermaid, OnChange, SubmitShortcut)
   117→- `src/styles/` — Vanilla Extract: 3 variants × 2 color schemes = 6 theme classes
   118→- `src/transformers/` — 14 Markdown shortcut transformers (alert `>[!NOTE]`, KaTeX `$$`, mention `@`, spoiler `||`, footnote `[^1]`, ruby, container, grid, quote, superscript/subscript, insert, rich-blocks, code-block)
   119→- `src/context/` — 5 contexts: `ColorSchemeContext` (light/dark), `RendererConfigContext` (custom renderer injection), `ImageUploadContext` (upload function injection), `FootnoteDefinitionsContext`, `NestedContentRendererContext`
   120→- `src/components/renderers/` — built-in default renderers (Alert, Banner, CodeBlock, Footnote, FootnoteSection, Grid, Image, KaTeX, LinkCard, Mention, Mermaid, Ruby, Video) + static decorators (Alert, Banner, Grid)
   121→- `src/components/decorators/` — edit decorators (Alert, Banner, CodeBlock, Grid)
   122→
   123→**Context Provider value stability**: Never pass object literals as context provider `value`. Primitives (string, function) can be passed directly (e.g. `ColorSchemeContext`, `ImageUploadContext`). Objects must be wrapped in `useMemo` (e.g. `RendererConfigContext`).
   124→
   125→### Custom Node Pattern
   126→
   127→All custom content nodes extend `DecoratorNode<ReactElement>`:
   128→
   129→```typescript
   130→class FooNode extends DecoratorNode<ReactElement> {
   131→  static importJSON(serialized) / exportJSON()
   132→  decorate() → <RendererWrapper type="Foo" props={...} />
   133→}
   134→export function $createFooNode(payload): FooNode
   135→export function $isFooNode(node): node is FooNode
   136→```
   137→
   138→`RendererWrapper` delegates to custom renderer (via `RendererConfig`) or falls back to built-in default.
   139→
   140→### Node: Edit / Render Split
   141→
   142→Nodes with heavy edit UI are split into two classes for tree-shaking:
   143→
   144→| Base Node (render-only) | Edit Node (editor-only) | Edit Dependency |
   145→|------------------------|------------------------|-----------------|
   146→| `AlertQuoteNode` | `AlertQuoteEditNode` | `AlertEditDecorator` + LexicalNestedComposer |
   147→| `BannerNode` | `BannerEditNode` | `BannerEditDecorator` + LexicalNestedComposer |
   148→| `CodeBlockNode` | `CodeBlockEditNode` | `CodeBlockEditDecorator` |
   149→| `FootnoteSectionNode` | `FootnoteSectionEditNode` | `FootnoteSectionEditRenderer` |
   150→| `GridContainerNode` | `GridEditNode` | `GridEditDecorator` |
   151→| `KaTeXBlockNode` | `KaTeXBlockEditNode`* | `KaTeXEditDecorator` + Popover |
   152→| `KaTeXInlineNode` | `KaTeXInlineEditNode`* | `KaTeXEditDecorator` + Popover |
   153→
   154→*KaTeX edit nodes live in `@haklex/rich-renderer-katex`, not in `rich-editor`.
   155→
   156→**Base node** `decorate()` returns `RendererWrapper` (or lightweight read-only decorator). No edit UI imports.
   157→
   158→**Edit node** extends base node, overrides `clone()` / `importJSON()` / `decorate()` to use the full edit decorator with heavy deps.
   159→
   160→Config files:
   161→- `src/config.ts` — `customNodes` / `allNodes` (render-only, used by `RichRenderer`)
   162→- `src/config-edit.ts` — `customEditNodes` / `allEditNodes` (edit nodes, used by `RichEditor`)
   163→
   164→**Adding a new node with edit UI**: Create base node with `RendererWrapper` in `decorate()`, then create `FooEditNode extends FooNode` overriding `decorate()` with edit decorator. Register base in `config.ts`, edit in `config-edit.ts`.
   165→
   166→### Plugin Pattern
   167→
   168→```typescript
   169→export const INSERT_FOO_COMMAND = createCommand<Payload>('INSERT_FOO_COMMAND')
   170→export function FooPlugin() {
   171→  const [editor] = useLexicalComposerContext()
   172→  useEffect(() => editor.registerCommand(INSERT_FOO_COMMAND, handler, COMMAND_PRIORITY_EDITOR), [editor])
   173→  return null
   174→}
   175→```
   176→
   177→## External Plugin Packages
   178→
   179→Plugins extracted into separate packages for independent versioning and tree-shaking:
   180→
   181→| Package | Key Export | Purpose |
   182→|---------|-----------|---------|
   183→| `@haklex/rich-plugin-block-handle` | `BlockHandlePlugin` | Block add button + context menu |
   184→| `@haklex/rich-plugin-floating-toolbar` | `FloatingToolbarPlugin` | Text formatting floating toolbar |
   185→| `@haklex/rich-plugin-link-edit` | `FloatingLinkEditorPlugin` | Inline link editing popover |
   186→| `@haklex/rich-plugin-mention` | `MentionMenuPlugin` | @ mention typeahead with platform selection |
   187→| `@haklex/rich-plugin-slash-menu` | `SlashMenuPlugin` | Typeahead slash commands for block insertion |
   188→| `@haklex/rich-plugin-table` | `TableCellResizerPlugin`, `TableRowColumnHandlesPlugin` | Table cell resizing + row/column handles |
   189→| `@haklex/rich-plugin-toolbar` | `ToolbarPlugin` | Top toolbar with formatting buttons, dropdowns, separators |
   190→
   191→All plugin packages depend on `@haklex/rich-style-token` for theming and export `./style.css`.
   192→
   193→## Extension Packages
   194→
   195→Extensions add complete features (nodes + renderers + plugins) with heavy isolated dependencies:
   196→
   197→| Package | Purpose | Key Deps |
   198→|---------|---------|----------|
   199→| `@haklex/rich-ext-code-snippet` | Multi-file code snippet with drag-reorder | `@haklex/cm-editor`, `@dnd-kit/*`, `shiki` |
   200→| `@haklex/rich-ext-embed` | URL embeds (Twitter, YouTube, Bilibili, Codesandbox, Gist, GitHub) | `react-tweet`, `lucide-react` |
   201→| `@haklex/rich-ext-excalidraw` | Excalidraw whiteboard (scene JSON + diff via jsondiffpatch) | `@excalidraw/excalidraw`, `jsondiffpatch` |
   202→| `@haklex/rich-ext-gallery` | Image gallery with drag-reorder and lightbox | `@dnd-kit/*`, `react-photo-view`, `thumbhash` |
   203→
   204→Extensions with static/edit split export dual entries: `./` (edit) and `./static` (render-only).
   205→
   206→## Variant System
   207→
   208→Controlled by `variant` prop + `ColorSchemeContext`. Theme CSS variables in `@haklex/rich-style-token` via `createThemeStyle()`.
   209→
   210→| Variant | Font | Size | Line-height | Max-width | Use case |
   211→|---------|------|------|-------------|-----------|----------|
   212→| article | system sans-serif | 16px | 1.75 | 65ch | Blog posts |
   213→| note | CJK serif (Noto Serif CJK SC) | 16px | 1.8 | 65ch | Personal notes |
   214→| comment | system sans-serif | 14px | 1.5 | none | Inline comments |
   215→
   216→## Renderer Config (Custom Renderer Injection)
   217→
   218→```typescript
   219→interface RendererConfig {
   220→  Alert?, Banner?, CodeBlock?, CodeSnippet?, Component?, Footnote?,
   221→  Gallery?, Image?, KaTeX?, LinkCard?, Mermaid?, Mention?,
   222→  Ruby?, Tabs?, Video?
   223→}
   224→<RichEditor rendererConfig={...} />
   225→<RichRenderer rendererConfig={...} />
   226→```
   227→
   228→## Individual Renderer Packages
   229→
   230→`@haklex/rich-renderer-*` packages provide feature-specific renderers with heavy dependencies isolated:
   231→- `alert` — GitHub-style alerts (info/warning/tip/caution/important)
   232→- `banner` — Colored banner container with nested content
   233→- `codeblock` — Shiki syntax highlighting
   234→- `image` — Blurhash/thumbhash, captions, accent colors
   235→- `katex` — KaTeX math equations (edit nodes only: `KaTeXBlockEditNode`, `KaTeXInlineEditNode`)
   236→- `linkcard` — Link preview cards
   237→- `mention` — Social platform mention badges
   238→- `mermaid` — Mermaid diagram rendering
   239→- `ruby` — Ruby annotation (furigana for Japanese text)
   240→- `video` — Responsive video players
   241→
   242→`@haklex/rich-renderers` aggregates all, with sub-path exports: `./codeblock`, `./mermaid`, etc.
   243→
   244→### Renderer: Edit / Static Split
   245→
   246→Renderer components with edit-only heavy deps are split into static and edit variants:
   247→
   248→| Package | Static (display-only) | Edit (with edit UI) | Edit Dependency |
   249→|---------|----------------------|---------------------|-----------------|
   250→| `rich-renderer-alert` | `AlertRenderer` | `AlertEditRenderer` | DropdownMenu (`@haklex/rich-editor-ui`) |
   251→| `rich-renderer-banner` | `BannerRenderer` | `BannerEditRenderer` | DropdownMenu + Popover (`@haklex/rich-editor-ui`) |
   252→| `rich-renderer-codeblock` | `CodeBlockRenderer` | `CodeBlockEditRenderer` | CodeMirror edit overlay |
   253→| `rich-renderer-image` | `ImageRenderer` | `ImageEditRenderer` | Upload/edit UI |
   254→| `rich-renderer-mention` | `MentionRenderer` | `MentionEditRenderer` | Popover (`@haklex/rich-editor-ui`) + lucide-react |
   255→| `rich-renderer-mermaid` | `MermaidRenderer` | `MermaidEditRenderer` | presentDialog (`@haklex/rich-editor-ui`) |
   256→| `rich-renderer-ruby` | `RubyRenderer` | `RubyEditRenderer` | Edit markup UI |
   257→| `rich-renderer-video` | `VideoRenderer` | `VideoEditRenderer` | Edit URL UI |
   258→| `rich-ext-code-snippet` | `CodeSnippetRenderer` | `CodeSnippetEditRenderer` | CodeMirror + @dnd-kit |
   259→| `rich-ext-excalidraw` | `ExcalidrawRenderer` | `ExcalidrawEditRenderer` | @excalidraw/excalidraw |
   260→| `rich-ext-gallery` | `GalleryRenderer` | `GalleryEditRenderer` | @dnd-kit + upload UI |
   261→
   262→Aggregator packages:
   263→- `@haklex/rich-renderers` — static-only. `enhancedRendererConfig` (`src/config.ts`), for `RichRenderer`. No edit deps.
   264→- `@haklex/rich-renderers-edit` — edit-only. `enhancedEditRendererConfig` (`src/config.ts`), for `RichEditor`. Spreads `enhancedRendererConfig` and overrides with edit variants. Also re-exports `FootnoteRenderer`.
   265→
   266→**Split criteria**: Only split when the edit path imports heavy deps (`@haklex/rich-editor-ui` components, `lucide-react` icons) absent from the static path. If edit logic is just a boolean flag with no extra imports, splitting adds complexity with no bundle benefit.
   267→
   268→**Adding a new renderer with edit UI**: Create `FooRenderer` (static) and `FooEditRenderer` (edit) in the same package. Export static from `./static` entry, edit from `./` entry. Add static to `enhancedRendererConfig` in `@haklex/rich-renderers`, edit to `enhancedEditRendererConfig` in `@haklex/rich-renderers-edit`.
   269→
   270→## Integration: @haklex/rich-kit-shiro
   271→
   272→Production bundle for the web app. Combines core + all renderers + all plugins + extensions.
   273→
   274→```typescript
   275→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/style.css'
   276→import { RichEditor } from '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/editor'       // → enhancedEditRendererConfig
   277→import { RichRenderer } from '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/renderer'   // → enhancedRendererConfig
   278→
   279→// Additional entry points:
   280→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/editor-core'     // core editor without renderers
   281→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/excalidraw'      // Excalidraw extension
   282→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/markdown'        // markdown conversion utilities
   283→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/nodes'           // all node classes
   284→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/plugins'         // all plugins
   285→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/renderers'       // static renderer config
   286→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/renderers-edit'  // edit renderer config
   287→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/style'           // style utilities
   288→```
   289→
   290→`ShiroEditor` uses `enhancedEditRendererConfig` (edit renderers). `ShiroRenderer` uses `enhancedRendererConfig` (static renderers). This ensures the renderer entry tree-shakes all edit UI deps (DropdownMenu, Popover, presentDialog, lucide-react edit icons).
   291→
   292→## Diff Viewer (@haklex/rich-diff)
   293→
   294→```typescript
   295→<RichDiff oldValue={...} newValue={...} variant="article" />
   296→```
   297→
   298→Compares two `SerializedEditorState` at node level. Side-by-side layout with insert/delete highlighting.
   299→
   300→## Build Configuration
   301→
   302→Shared Vite config factory in `haklex/vite.shared.ts` (`createViteConfig()`). Each package's `vite.config.ts` calls it with package-specific options (entry points, vanillaExtract toggle).
   303→
   304→- Auto-externalizes all `dependencies` + `peerDependencies` from each package's `package.json`
   305→- Vanilla Extract plugin for CSS-in-TS → static CSS (zero runtime)
   306→- Output: ESM `.mjs` + `.d.ts` declarations (via `vite-plugin-dts`)
   307→- Target: ES2020, no minification for JS, CSS minified
   308→
   309→## Styling
   310→
   311→Vanilla Extract (`*.css.ts` files) throughout. No Tailwind in editor packages. Theme contract defines CSS variables for colors, spacing, typography, and border-radius. Each variant+colorScheme combination produces a class name applied to the editor root.
   312→
   313→### Neutral colors
   314→
   315→Use a **neutral** (gray) color palette for secondary/muted text, borders, section labels, and descriptions—e.g. `#737373` / `#a3a3a3` (Tailwind neutral-500/400). Avoid tinted grays (slate, zinc, blue-gray) unless a design explicitly requires them. This keeps UI elements like slash menu sections and descriptions hue-neutral.

     1→import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
     2→import { resolve } from 'node:path'
     3→
     4→import type { UserConfig } from 'vite'
     5→
     6→export interface SharedViteOptions {
     7→  entry?: string | Record<string, string>
     8→  vanillaExtract?: boolean
     9→  esbuild?: { jsx: string; jsxImportSource: string }
    10→}
    11→
    12→const BASE_EXTERNALS = ['react', 'react-dom', 'react/jsx-runtime']
    13→
    14→export async function createViteConfig(
    15→  options: SharedViteOptions = {},
    16→): Promise<UserConfig> {
    17→  const { entry = 'src/index.ts', vanillaExtract = true, esbuild } = options
    18→
    19→  const dts = (await import('vite-plugin-dts')).default
    20→  const plugins: UserConfig['plugins'] = []
    21→
    22→  if (vanillaExtract) {
    23→    const { vanillaExtractPlugin } =
    24→      await import('@vanilla-extract/vite-plugin')
    25→    plugins.push(vanillaExtractPlugin())
    26→  }
    27→
    28→  plugins.push(
    29→    dts({ entryRoot: 'src', outDir: 'dist', tsconfigPath: './tsconfig.json' }),
    30→  )
    31→
    32→  const cwd = process.cwd()
    33→  const isMap = typeof entry !== 'string'
    34→  const libEntry = isMap
    35→    ? Object.fromEntries(
    36→        Object.entries(entry).map(([k, v]) => [k, resolve(cwd, v)]),
    37→      )
    38→    : resolve(cwd, entry)
    39→
    40→  const fileName = isMap
    41→    ? (_: string, name: string) => `${name}.mjs`
    42→    : () => 'index.mjs'
    43→
    44→  const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(resolve(cwd, 'package.json'), 'utf-8'))
    45→  const depNames = new Set([
    46→    ...BASE_EXTERNALS,
    47→    ...Object.keys(pkg.dependencies || {}),
    48→    ...Object.keys(pkg.peerDependencies || {}),
    49→  ])
    50→
    51→  const rollupExternal = (id: string) => {
    52→    if (id[0] === '.' || id[0] === '/' || id[0] === '\0') return false
    53→    if (depNames.has(id)) return true
    54→    const slashIdx = id.indexOf('/')
    55→    if (slashIdx > 0) {
    56→      const pkgName =
    57→        id[0] === '@'
    58→          ? id.slice(0, id.indexOf('/', slashIdx + 1))
    59→          : id.slice(0, slashIdx)
    60→      return pkgName ? depNames.has(pkgName) : false
    61→    }
    62→    return false
    63→  }
    64→
    65→  return {
    66→    plugins,
    67→    ...(esbuild && { esbuild }),
    68→    build: {
    69→      lib: { entry: libEntry, formats: ['es'], fileName },
    70→      rollupOptions: {
    71→        external: rollupExternal,
    72→        output: { preserveModules: false },
    73→      },
    74→      cssCodeSplit: false,
    75→      minify: false,
    76→      cssMinify: true,
    77→      target: 'es2020',
    78→    },
    79→  }
    80→}
    81→

     1→/**
     2→ * Bumpp 发布流程配置
     3→ * @see https://github.com/antfu-collective/bumpp
     4→ *
     5→ * 脚本:
     6→ * - pnpm run release        递归 bump 所有 workspace 包 → commit → tag → push
     7→ * - pnpm run release:rich   同上，且在 commit 前执行 build:rich + publish:rich（发布 @haklex/*）
     8→ * - pnpm run release:dry    bump 所有包，不 commit/tag/push（仅看版本变化）
     9→ *
    10→ * 基准版本以 packages/rich-editor 的 version 为准。
    11→ */
    12→import { defineConfig } from 'bumpp'
    13→
    14→import richEditorPkg from './packages/rich-editor/package.json'
    15→
    16→export default defineConfig({
    17→  /** 基准版本：与 packages/rich-editor 保持一致 */
    18→  currentVersion: (richEditorPkg as { version: string }).version,
    19→  commit: false,
    20→  tag: false,
    21→  push: false,
    22→  /** 允许有未提交改动时 bump（CI 或本地试跑时有用） */
    23→  noGitCheck: true,
    24→  /** commit 时包含所有已改文件（含 lockfile） */
    25→  all: false,
    26→  /** 交互确认，看清将要 bump 的版本再继续 */
    27→  confirm: false,
    28→  /** 只 bump 根与 packages/* */
    29→  files: ['package.json', 'pnpm-lock.yaml', 'packages/**/package.json'],
    30→})
    31→
```

     1→import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
     2→
     3→import {
     4→  CURSOR_TOKEN,
     5→  filterKaTeXSnippets,
     6→  insertSnippetAtSelection,
     7→} from '../src/snippets'
     8→
     9→describe('insertSnippetAtSelection', () => {
    10→  it('inserts snippet at current cursor position and moves cursor to placeholder', () => {
    11→    const result = insertSnippetAtSelection(
    12→      'E = mc^2',
    13→      ` + \\frac{1}{${CURSOR_TOKEN}}`,
    14→      8,
    15→      8,
    16→    )
    17→
    18→    expect(result.value).toBe('E = mc^2 + \\frac{1}{}')
    19→    expect(result.selectionStart).toBe(20)
    20→    expect(result.selectionEnd).toBe(20)
    21→  })
    22→
    23→  it('replaces current selection before moving cursor to placeholder', () => {
    24→    const result = insertSnippetAtSelection(
    25→      'x + y',
    26→      `\\sqrt{${CURSOR_TOKEN}}`,
    27→      0,
    28→      5,
    29→    )
    30→
    31→    expect(result.value).toBe('\\sqrt{}')
    32→    expect(result.selectionStart).toBe(6)
    33→    expect(result.selectionEnd).toBe(6)
    34→  })
    35→
    36→  it('falls back to appending when selection is unavailable', () => {
    37→    const result = insertSnippetAtSelection('a+b', '\\theta', null, null)
    38→
    39→    expect(result.value).toBe('a+b\\theta')
    40→    expect(result.selectionStart).toBe(9)
    41→    expect(result.selectionEnd).toBe(9)
    42→  })
    43→})
    44→
    45→describe('filterKaTeXSnippets', () => {
    46→  it('matches snippets by name, keyword, and category', () => {
    47→    const byName = filterKaTeXSnippets('frac')
    48→    const byKeyword = filterKaTeXSnippets('root')
    49→    const byCategory = filterKaTeXSnippets('greek')
    50→
    51→    expect(byName.some((snippet) => snippet.id === 'frac')).toBe(true)
    52→    expect(byKeyword.some((snippet) => snippet.id === 'sqrt')).toBe(true)
    53→    expect(byCategory.every((snippet) => snippet.category === 'Greek')).toBe(
    54→      true,
    55→    )
    56→  })
    57→})
    58→

     1→import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
     2→import { resolve } from 'node:path'
     3→
     4→import type { UserConfig } from 'vite'
     5→
     6→export interface SharedViteOptions {
     7→  entry?: string | Record<string, string>
     8→  vanillaExtract?: boolean
     9→  esbuild?: { jsx: string; jsxImportSource: string }
    10→}
    11→
    12→const BASE_EXTERNALS = ['react', 'react-dom', 'react/jsx-runtime']
    13→
    14→export async function createViteConfig(
    15→  options: SharedViteOptions = {},
    16→): Promise<UserConfig> {
    17→  const { entry = 'src/index.ts', vanillaExtract = true, esbuild } = options
    18→
    19→  const dts = (await import('vite-plugin-dts')).default
    20→  const plugins: UserConfig['plugins'] = []
    21→
    22→  if (vanillaExtract) {
    23→    const { vanillaExtractPlugin } =
    24→      await import('@vanilla-extract/vite-plugin')
    25→    plugins.push(vanillaExtractPlugin())
    26→  }
    27→
    28→  plugins.push(
    29→    dts({ entryRoot: 'src', outDir: 'dist', tsconfigPath: './tsconfig.json' }),
    30→  )
    31→
    32→  const cwd = process.cwd()
    33→  const isMap = typeof entry !== 'string'
    34→  const libEntry = isMap
    35→    ? Object.fromEntries(
    36→        Object.entries(entry).map(([k, v]) => [k, resolve(cwd, v)]),
    37→      )
    38→    : resolve(cwd, entry)
    39→
    40→  const fileName = isMap
    41→    ? (_: string, name: string) => `${name}.mjs`
    42→    : () => 'index.mjs'
    43→
    44→  const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(resolve(cwd, 'package.json'), 'utf-8'))
    45→  const depNames = new Set([
    46→    ...BASE_EXTERNALS,
    47→    ...Object.keys(pkg.dependencies || {}),
    48→    ...Object.keys(pkg.peerDependencies || {}),
    49→  ])
    50→
    51→  const rollupExternal = (id: string) => {
    52→    if (id[0] === '.' || id[0] === '/' || id[0] === '\0') return false
    53→    if (depNames.has(id)) return true
    54→    const slashIdx = id.indexOf('/')
    55→    if (slashIdx > 0) {
    56→      const pkgName =
    57→        id[0] === '@'
    58→          ? id.slice(0, id.indexOf('/', slashIdx + 1))
    59→          : id.slice(0, slashIdx)
    60→      return pkgName ? depNames.has(pkgName) : false
    61→    }
    62→    return false
    63→  }
    64→
    65→  return {
    66→    plugins,
    67→    ...(esbuild && { esbuild }),
    68→    build: {
    69→      lib: { entry: libEntry, formats: ['es'], fileName },
    70→      rollupOptions: {
    71→        external: rollupExternal,
    72→        output: { preserveModules: false },
    73→      },
    74→      cssCodeSplit: false,
    75→      minify: false,
    76→      cssMinify: true,
    77→      target: 'es2020',
    78→    },
    79→  }
    80→}
    81→

     1→# CLAUDE.md
     2→
     3→This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
     4→
     5→## Project Overview
     6→
     7→This is "Shiroi" (白い) - a private/closed-source iteration of the Shiro blog system. It's a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo containing a Next.js-based personal blogging platform with advanced features including:
     8→
     9→- Personal blog with posts, notes, pages, and "thinking" entries
    10→- Real-time features with Socket.IO
    11→- Activity tracking and owner status
    12→- Comment system with authentication
    13→- Search functionality powered by Algolia
    14→- Dashboard for content management
    15→- Theme customization with accent colors
    16→- RSS feeds and sitemap generation
    17→
    18→## Architecture
    19→
    20→### Tech Stack
    21→- **Monorepo**: pnpm workspaces + Turborepo
    22→- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router)
    23→- **Language**: TypeScript
    24→- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS + custom semantic theme tokens + UIKit-inspired colors
    25→- **State Management**: Jotai for client state
    26→- **Data Fetching**: TanStack Query (React Query)
    27→- **API**: Custom API client from `@shiro/fetch` package
    28→- **Authentication**: better-auth + custom token system
    29→- **Animation**: Motion (Framer Motion) with lazy loading
    30→- **Icons**: Tailwind CSS Icons with Mingcute and Material Symbols collections
    31→
    32→### Project Structure
    33→```
    34→Shiroi/
    35→├── apps/
    36→│   └── web/                    # Next.js main application (@shiro/web)
    37→│       ├── src/
    38→│       │   ├── app/            # Next.js App Router pages and API routes
    39→│       │   ├── components/     # React components (common/, layout/, modules/, ui/)
    40→│       │   ├── providers/      # Context providers for state management
    41→│       │   ├── hooks/          # Custom React hooks
    42→│       │   ├── lib/            # Utility functions and configurations
    43→│       │   └── queries/        # TanStack Query definitions and hooks
    44→│       ├── public/
    45→│       ├── next.config.mjs
    46→│       ├── tsconfig.json
    47→│       └── package.json
    48→├── packages/
    49→│   ├── fetch/                  # @shiro/fetch - Custom API client
    50→│   ├── rich-editor/            # @haklex/rich-editor - Lexical rich text editor
    51→│   └── types/                  # shiro-types - Shared type definitions
    52→├── package.json                # Workspace root
    53→├── pnpm-workspace.yaml
    54→├── turbo.json
    55→└── eslint.config.mjs
    56→```
    57→
    58→### Component Architecture
    59→- Uses functional components with hooks
    60→- Component composition with provider pattern
    61→- Tailwind variants for styling with `tailwind-variants`
    62→- Motion components for animations
    63→- Modular UI components following atomic design principles
    64→
    65→### State Management
    66→- **Jotai**: Client-side state atoms (owner status, UI state, etc.)
    67→- **TanStack Query**: Server state management and caching
    68→- **Context Providers**: Feature-specific state (current note/post data)
    69→
    70→### API & Data Fetching
    71→- Custom API client (`@shiro/fetch`) that extends the MX-Space API
    72→- TanStack Query for data fetching with proper caching
    73→- Server-side data fetching for initial page loads
    74→- Real-time updates via Socket.IO
    75→
    76→## Development Commands
    77→
    78→```bash
    79→# Monorepo-wide (via Turborepo)
    80→pnpm dev                 # Start all dev servers
    81→pnpm build               # Build all packages
    82→pnpm lint                # Lint all packages
    83→
    84→# Web app specific
    85→pnpm --filter @shiro/web dev       # Start Next.js dev server on port 2323
    86→pnpm --filter @shiro/web build     # Production build
    87→pnpm --filter @shiro/web lint      # ESLint with auto-fix
    88→
    89→# Packages
    90→pnpm --filter @haklex/rich-editor build   # Build rich editor
    91→pnpm --filter @haklex/rich-editor dev     # Rich editor dev playground
    92→```
    93→
    94→## Configuration Files
    95→
    96→- **apps/web/next.config.mjs**: Next.js configuration with bundle analysis, image optimization, custom webpack config
    97→- **apps/web/src/styles/tailwindcss.css**: Tailwind CSS v4 CSS-first config, semantic theme tokens, UIKit colors, plugins
    98→- **eslint.config.mjs**: ESLint configuration using `eslint-config-hyoban` (root level)
    99→- **apps/web/tsconfig.json**: TypeScript configuration
   100→- **turbo.json**: Turborepo task pipeline configuration
   101→- **pnpm-workspace.yaml**: Workspace package definitions
   102→
   103→## Code Conventions
   104→
   105→### Component Patterns
   106→- Use `'use client'` directive for client components
   107→- Export components as named exports when possible
   108→- Use Tailwind variants with `tailwind-variants` library
   109→- Implement proper loading states and error boundaries
   110→
   111→### Color System & Theming
   112→- **Dynamic Accent Colors**: Uses `AccentColorStyleInjector` with predefined color palettes for light/dark themes
   113→  - Light theme: 浅葱 (`#33A6B8`), warm colors with 40-70% lightness
   114→  - Dark theme: 桃 (`#F596AA`), complementary colors with 20-50% lightness
   115→- **UIKit-inspired Color Palette**: Complete semantic color system (primary, secondary, tertiary, etc.)
   116→- **CSS Variables**: Uses OKLCH color space for consistent color manipulation via `--a` variable
   117→- **Page-specific Gradients**: `PageColorGradient` component creates dynamic background gradients based on content seed or base color
   118→- **Noise Textures**: Background texture generation using PNG noise patterns with chroma.js color mixing
   119→- **Material Design Backdrop**: Multiple backdrop blur levels (thick, default, thin, ultrathin) for glassmorphism effects
   120→
   121→### Styling Conventions
   122→- Tailwind CSS classes with custom semantic theme tokens
   123→- UIKit-inspired color system with light/dark theme support
   124→- Use `clsx` for conditional class names
   125→- Consistent spacing and typography scales
   126→- Access dynamic theme colors via `theme(colors.accent)` in CSS
   127→- Custom CSS variables for gradients: `--gradient-from` and `--gradient-to`
   128→
   129→### State Management Patterns
   130→- Use Jotai atoms for simple client state
   131→- TanStack Query for server state with proper keys
   132→- Context providers for feature-specific data sharing
   133→- Custom hooks for complex state logic
   134→
   135→### API Patterns
   136→- Use the custom `apiClient` from `@shiro/fetch`
   137→- Define query keys in `apps/web/src/queries/keys/`
   138→- Implement proper error handling and loading states
   139→- Use Server Components for initial data fetching when possible
   140→
   141→## Testing & Quality
   142→
   143→- ESLint configuration with React and Next.js rules
   144→- Prettier formatting (handled by lint-staged)
   145→- Pre-commit hooks with simple-git-hooks
   146→- Bundle size monitoring with Next.js bundle analyzer
   147→
   148→## Key Dependencies
   149→
   150→### Core
   151→- `next` - Next.js framework

     5→## Project Overview

     7→MX Space is a personal blog server application built with NestJS, MongoDB, and Redis. This is a monorepo containing the core server application and related packages. The main application is located in `apps/core/`.

    11→- **Dashboard (admin-vue3)**: `../admin-vue3` - 后台管理面板，Vue 3 项目

    19→## Development Commands
    20→
    21→All commands should be run from the repository root unless specified otherwise.
    22→
    23→### Core Commands
    24→- `pnpm dev` - Start development server
    25→- `pnpm build` - Build the project
    26→- `pnpm bundle` - Create production bundle
    27→- `pnpm test` - Run all tests
    28→- `pnpm lint` - Run ESLint
    29→- `pnpm format` - Format code with Prettier
    30→
    31→### Running Single Tests
    32→```bash
    33→# Run a single test file
    34→pnpm test -- test/src/modules/user/user.service.spec.ts
    35→
    36→# Run tests matching a pattern
    37→pnpm test -- --testNamePattern="should create user"
    38→
    39→# Run tests in watch mode
    40→pnpm -C apps/core run test:watch
    41→```
    42→
    43→### Core App Commands (from `apps/core/`)
    44→- `npm run start:debug` - Start with debug mode
    45→- `npm run start:cluster` - Start in cluster mode
    46→- `npm run repl` - Start REPL mode
    47→
    48→## Architecture Overview
    49→
    50→### Directory Structure
    51→- `apps/core/src/modules/` - Business logic modules (auth, posts, comments, etc.)
    52→- `apps/core/src/processors/` - Infrastructure services (database, redis, gateway, helpers)
    53→- `apps/core/src/common/` - Shared utilities (guards, interceptors, decorators)
    54→- `apps/core/src/migration/` - Database migration scripts
    55→- `apps/core/test/` - Test files and mocks
    56→- `packages/` - Shared packages (api-client, webhook)
    57→
    58→### Key Architectural Patterns
    59→
    60→**API Route Prefix**: The `@ApiController()` decorator adds `/api/v{version}` prefix in production but no prefix in development. This allows direct access during development.
    61→
    62→**Processors**: Infrastructure services organized in `processors/`:
    63→- `database/` - MongoDB connection and model registration
    64→- `redis/` - Redis caching and pub/sub
    65→- `gateway/` - WebSocket gateways for real-time features
    66→- `helper/` - Utility services (email, image, JWT, etc.)
    67→
    68→**Database Models**: Uses Mongoose with TypeGoose. All models extend a base with `_id`, `created`, `updated` fields.
    69→
    70→**Authentication**: JWT-based with decorators `@Auth()` for route protection and `@CurrentUser()` for accessing the authenticated user.
    71→
    72→## API Response Rules
    73→
    74→`ResponseInterceptor` auto-wraps responses:
    75→- **Array** → `{ data: [...] }` (always wrapped)
    76→- **Object** → returned directly (no wrapper)
    77→- **@Paginator** → `{ data: [...], pagination: {...} }` (requires `model.paginate()` result)
    78→- **@Bypass** → skips all transformation
    79→
    80→`JSONTransformInterceptor` converts all keys to **snake_case** (e.g., `createdAt` → `created_at`)
    81→
    82→## Testing
    83→
    84→Uses Vitest with in-memory MongoDB and Redis.
    85→
    86→### E2E Test Pattern
    87→Use `createE2EApp` helper from `test/helper/create-e2e-app.ts`:
    88→```typescript
    89→const proxy = createE2EApp({
    90→  imports: [...],
    91→  controllers: [MyController],
    92→  providers: [...],
    93→  models: [MyModel],
    94→  pourData: async (modelMap) => {
    95→    // Insert test data
    96→    const model = modelMap.get(MyModel)!.model
    97→    await model.create({ ... })
    98→  }
    99→})
   100→
   101→it('should work', async () => {
   102→  const res = await proxy.app.inject({ method: 'GET', url: '/...' })
   103→  expect(res.statusCode).toBe(200)
   104→})
   105→```
   106→
   107→### Test Mocks
   108→- `test/mock/modules/` - Module-level mocks (auth, redis, gateway)
   109→- `test/mock/processors/` - Processor mocks (email, event)
   110→- `test/helper/` - Test utilities (db-mock, redis-mock)
   111→
   112→## Database Migrations
   113→
   114→Migration scripts in `src/migration/version/` are version-based and run automatically on startup when needed.
   115→
   116→## Configuration
   117→
   118→Configuration via `src/app.config.ts` supports:
   119→- Environment variables
   120→- Command line arguments
   121→- YAML configuration files
   122→

     2→
     3→This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
     4→
     5→## Overview
     6→
     7→Lexical-based rich editor ecosystem. Modular packages: core editor, UI primitives, content renderers, plugins, extensions, and integration bundles.
     8→
     9→**Build**: Vite 7 + Vanilla Extract CSS-in-TS. ESM only (`.mjs`). TypeScript 5.9. Lexical 0.41.
    10→
    11→## Terminology: Static / Edit Split
    12→
    13→The editor ecosystem splits both **nodes** and **renderers** into static (read-only) and edit (editor-only) variants for bundle optimization.
    14→
    15→### Four Concepts
    16→
    17→| Term | Layer | Purpose | Example |
    18→|------|-------|---------|---------|
    19→| **Static Node** | Lexical node class | Deserialize JSON + `decorate()` returns `RendererWrapper`. No edit UI imports. | `CodeBlockNode`, `AlertQuoteNode` |
    20→| **Edit Node** | Lexical node class | Extends static node, overrides `decorate()` to use edit decorator with heavy deps (Popover, NestedComposer, etc.) | `CodeBlockEditNode`, `AlertQuoteEditNode` |
    21→| **Static Renderer** | React component | Display-only rendering. No `@haklex/rich-editor-ui` or `lucide-react` imports. | `AlertRenderer`, `MermaidRenderer` |
    22→| **Edit Renderer** | React component | Adds edit UI (DropdownMenu, Popover, presentDialog). Imports `@haklex/rich-editor-ui`. | `AlertEditRenderer`, `MermaidEditRenderer` |
    23→
    24→### Bundle Optimization Strategy
    25→
    26→```
    27→RichRenderer (read-only display)          RichEditor (full editing)
    28→├── Static Nodes (config.ts)              ├── Edit Nodes (config-edit.ts)
    29→├── Static Renderers                      ├── Edit Renderers
    30→│   (enhancedRendererConfig)              │   (enhancedEditRendererConfig)
    31→└── Zero edit UI deps                     └── Full edit UI deps
    32→```
    33→
    34→**Key principle**: `RichRenderer` entry imports only static nodes + static renderers, so bundlers tree-shake all edit UI deps (`@haklex/rich-editor-ui`, `lucide-react`, `LexicalNestedComposer`). `RichEditor` entry imports edit nodes + edit renderers that bring in these deps.
    35→
    36→**Split criteria**: Only split when the edit path introduces heavy imports absent from the static path. If edit logic is just a boolean prop with no extra imports (e.g. CodeBlock's `editable`), no split needed.
    37→
    38→### Registration
    39→
    40→| Config file | Contains | Used by |

    42→| `@haklex/rich-editor` `src/config.ts` | `customNodes` / `allNodes` (16 static nodes) | `RichRenderer` |
    43→| `@haklex/rich-editor` `src/config-edit.ts` | `customEditNodes` / `allEditNodes` (edit variants) | `RichEditor` |
    44→| `@haklex/rich-renderers` `src/config.ts` | `enhancedRendererConfig` (11 static renderers) | `ShiroRenderer` |
    45→| `@haklex/rich-renderers-edit` `src/config.ts` | `enhancedEditRendererConfig` (12 edit renderers) | `ShiroEditor` |

   121→## Foundation Packages
   122→
   123→### @haklex/rich-style-token
   124→
   125→Centralized theme tokens and CSS variables. Provides `createThemeStyle()`, variant presets (`articleTheme`, `noteTheme`, `commentTheme`), color constants (`darkColors`, `lightArticleColors`), layout constants, and `PortalThemeProvider` for shadow DOM theming. Used by nearly all packages.
   126→
   127→### @haklex/rich-headless
   128→
   129→Server-side Lexical node registry with zero React dependency. Exports `allHeadlessNodes` (20 node classes for JSON parsing), `allHeadlessTransformers`, and `$toMarkdown()`. Two entry points: `./` (nodes) and `./transformers` (markdown conversion).
   130→
   131→### @haklex/cm-editor
   132→
   133→Shared CodeMirror 6 utilities: `baseTheme`, `getThemeExtensions()`, `loadLanguageExtension()`. Used by `rich-ext-code-snippet` and `rich-renderer-codeblock` for code editing.
   134→
   135→## Core: @haklex/rich-editor
   136→
   137→Four entry points: `./` (all), `./editor` (RichEditor), `./static` (RichRenderer), `./styles` (CSS variables only).
   138→
   139→### Directory Layout
   140→
   141→- `src/nodes/` — 16 custom `DecoratorNode` types (Spoiler, Mention, KaTeXInline, KaTeXBlock, Image, AlertQuote, CodeBlock, Footnote, FootnoteSection, Video, LinkCard, Details, GridContainer, Banner, Mermaid, Ruby) + 5 edit variants (AlertQuoteEdit, BannerEdit, CodeBlockEdit, FootnoteSectionEdit, GridEdit)
   142→- `src/plugins/` — 18 Lexical plugins (Alert, AutoFocus, AutoLink, BlockExit, BlockId, DragDrop, EditorRef, Footnote, HorizontalRule, Image, ImageUpload, KaTeX, MarkdownShortcuts, Mermaid, OnChange, SubmitShortcut)
   143→- `src/styles/` — Vanilla Extract: 3 variants × 2 color schemes = 6 theme classes
   144→- `src/transformers/` — 14 Markdown shortcut transformers (alert `>[!NOTE]`, KaTeX `$$`, mention `@`, spoiler `||`, footnote `[^1]`, ruby, container, grid, quote, superscript/subscript, insert, rich-blocks, code-block)
   145→- `src/context/` — 5 contexts: `ColorSchemeContext` (light/dark), `RendererConfigContext` (custom renderer injection), `ImageUploadContext` (upload function injection), `FootnoteDefinitionsContext`, `NestedContentRendererContext`
   146→- `src/components/renderers/` — built-in default renderers (Alert, Banner, CodeBlock, Footnote, FootnoteSection, Grid, Image, KaTeX, LinkCard, Mention, Mermaid, Ruby, Video) + static decorators (Alert, Banner, Grid)
   147→- `src/components/decorators/` — edit decorators (Alert, Banner, CodeBlock, Grid)
   148→
   149→**Context Provider value stability**: Never pass object literals as context provider `value`. Primitives (string, function) can be passed directly (e.g. `ColorSchemeContext`, `ImageUploadContext`). Objects must be wrapped in `useMemo` (e.g. `RendererConfigContext`).
   150→
   151→### Custom Node Pattern
   152→
   153→All custom content nodes extend `DecoratorNode<ReactElement>`:
   154→
   155→```typescript
   156→class FooNode extends DecoratorNode<ReactElement> {
   157→  static importJSON(serialized) / exportJSON()
   158→  decorate() → <RendererWrapper type="Foo" props={...} />
   159→}
   160→export function $createFooNode(payload): FooNode
   161→export function $isFooNode(node): node is FooNode
   162→```
   163→
   164→`RendererWrapper` delegates to custom renderer (via `RendererConfig`) or falls back to built-in default.
   165→
   166→### Node: Edit / Render Split
   167→
   168→Nodes with heavy edit UI are split into two classes for tree-shaking:
   169→
   170→| Base Node (render-only) | Edit Node (editor-only) | Edit Dependency |
   171→|------------------------|------------------------|-----------------|
   172→| `AlertQuoteNode` | `AlertQuoteEditNode` | `AlertEditDecorator` + LexicalNestedComposer |
   173→| `BannerNode` | `BannerEditNode` | `BannerEditDecorator` + LexicalNestedComposer |
   174→| `CodeBlockNode` | `CodeBlockEditNode` | `CodeBlockEditDecorator` |
   175→| `FootnoteSectionNode` | `FootnoteSectionEditNode` | `FootnoteSectionEditRenderer` |
   176→| `GridContainerNode` | `GridEditNode` | `GridEditDecorator` |
   177→| `KaTeXBlockNode` | `KaTeXBlockEditNode`* | `KaTeXEditDecorator` + Popover |
   178→| `KaTeXInlineNode` | `KaTeXInlineEditNode`* | `KaTeXEditDecorator` + Popover |
   179→
   180→*KaTeX edit nodes live in `@haklex/rich-renderer-katex`, not in `rich-editor`.
   181→
   182→**Base node** `decorate()` returns `RendererWrapper` (or lightweight read-only decorator). No edit UI imports.
   183→
   184→**Edit node** extends base node, overrides `clone()` / `importJSON()` / `decorate()` to use the full edit decorator with heavy deps.
   185→
   186→Config files:
   187→- `src/config.ts` — `customNodes` / `allNodes` (render-only, used by `RichRenderer`)
   188→- `src/config-edit.ts` — `customEditNodes` / `allEditNodes` (edit nodes, used by `RichEditor`)
   189→
   190→**Adding a new node with edit UI**: Create base node with `RendererWrapper` in `decorate()`, then create `FooEditNode extends FooNode` overriding `decorate()` with edit decorator. Register base in `config.ts`, edit in `config-edit.ts`.
   191→
   192→### Plugin Pattern
   193→
   194→```typescript
   195→export const INSERT_FOO_COMMAND = createCommand<Payload>('INSERT_FOO_COMMAND')
   196→export function FooPlugin() {
   197→  const [editor] = useLexicalComposerContext()
   198→  useEffect(() => editor.registerCommand(INSERT_FOO_COMMAND, handler, COMMAND_PRIORITY_EDITOR), [editor])
   199→  return null
   200→}
   201→```

   221→Extensions add complete features (nodes + renderers + plugins) with heavy isolated dependencies:
   222→
   223→| Package | Purpose | Key Deps |

   232→## Variant System
   233→
   234→Controlled by `variant` prop + `ColorSchemeContext`. Theme CSS variables in `@haklex/rich-style-token` via `createThemeStyle()`.

   236→| Variant | Font | Size | Line-height | Max-width | Use case |
   237→|---------|------|------|-------------|-----------|----------|
   238→| article | system sans-serif | 16px | 1.75 | 65ch | Blog posts |
   239→| note | CJK serif (Noto Serif CJK SC) | 16px | 1.8 | 65ch | Personal notes |

   242→## Renderer Config (Custom Renderer Injection)
   243→
   244→```typescript
   245→interface RendererConfig {
   246→  Alert?, Banner?, CodeBlock?, CodeSnippet?, Component?, Footnote?,
   247→  Gallery?, Image?, KaTeX?, LinkCard?, Mermaid?, Mention?,
   248→  Ruby?, Tabs?, Video?
   249→}

   253→
   254→## Individual Renderer Packages
   255→
   256→`@haklex/rich-renderer-*` packages provide feature-specific renderers with heavy dependencies isolated:
   257→- `alert` — GitHub-style alerts (info/warning/tip/caution/important)

   269→
   270→### Renderer: Edit / Static Split
   271→
   272→Renderer components with edit-only heavy deps are split into static and edit variants:
   273→
   274→| Package | Static (display-only) | Edit (with edit UI) | Edit Dependency |

   288→Aggregator packages:
   289→- `@haklex/rich-renderers` — static-only. `enhancedRendererConfig` (`src/config.ts`), for `RichRenderer`. No edit deps.
   290→- `@haklex/rich-renderers-edit` — edit-only. `enhancedEditRendererConfig` (`src/config.ts`), for `RichEditor`. Spreads `enhancedRendererConfig` and overrides with edit variants. Also re-exports `FootnoteRenderer`.
   291→
   292→**Split criteria**: Only split when the edit path imports heavy deps (`@haklex/rich-editor-ui` components, `lucide-react` icons) absent from the static path. If edit logic is just a boolean flag with no extra imports, splitting adds complexity with no bundle benefit.

   294→**Adding a new renderer with edit UI**: Create `FooRenderer` (static) and `FooEditRenderer` (edit) in the same package. Export static from `./static` entry, edit from `./` entry. Add static to `enhancedRendererConfig` in `@haklex/rich-renderers`, edit to `enhancedEditRendererConfig` in `@haklex/rich-renderers-edit`.

   297→
   298→Production bundle for the web app. Combines core + all renderers + all plugins + extensions.

   303→import { RichRenderer } from '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/renderer'   // → enhancedRendererConfig
   304→
   305→// Additional entry points:
   306→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/editor-core'     // core editor without renderers
   307→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/excalidraw'      // Excalidraw extension
   308→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/markdown'        // markdown conversion utilities
   309→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/nodes'           // all node classes
   310→import '@haklex/rich-kit-shiro/plugins'         // all plugins

   327→
   328→Shared Vite config factory in `haklex/vite.shared.ts` (`createViteConfig()`). Each package's `vite.config.ts` calls it with package-specific options (entry points, vanillaExtract toggle).
   329→

   335→## Downstream Consumers
   336→
   337→haklex packages are published to npm as `@haklex/*`, consumed by three downstream projects:
   338→
   339→| Consumer | Path | Packages Used | Integration |
   340→|----------|------|---------------|-------------|
   341→| **Shiroi** (Next.js frontend) | `../Shiroi` | `@haklex/rich-kit-shiro` (workspace link via `haklex/*`) | Native React — `ShiroEditor` / `ShiroRenderer` |

   344→
   345→**Shiroi is the original host** — `haklex/` lives inside `Shiroi/` as a pnpm workspace member (`haklex/*` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`). This standalone repo (`../haklex`) is the extracted version for independent development.

````md
# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Overview

Lexical-based rich editor ecosystem. Modular packages: core editor, UI primitives, content renderers, plugins, extensions, and integration bundles.

**Build**: Vite 7 + Vanilla Extract CSS-in-TS. ESM only (`.mjs`). TypeScript 5.9. Lexical 0.41. pnpm 10. Node >= 20.

## Commands

\```bash
pnpm dev # dev playground (all features)
pnpm --filter @haklex/rich-editor dev:build # watch mode for core
pnpm build # turbo build (all)
pnpm build:packages # all except demo
pnpm --filter @haklex/rich-editor build # single package
pnpm lint # turbo lint (all)
npx eslint path/to/file.ts # lint single file
npx prettier --write path/to/file.ts # format single file
npx vitest run packages/rich-renderer-katex/tests/ # run specific tests
pnpm release:rich # bump + build + publish @haklex/\*
\```

## Toolchain

- **ESLint**: `eslint-config-hyoban`. Key rule: `react/no-use-context: 'error'` — must use React 19 `use(Context)` not `useContext()`.
- **Versioning**: All `@haklex/*` share one version (from `packages/rich-editor/package.json`), managed by `bumpp`.
- **Pre-commit**: `simple-git-hooks` + `lint-staged` (prettier + eslint on staged files).
- **Build**: Shared Vite config in `vite.shared.ts` (`createViteConfig()`). Auto-externalizes deps/peerDeps. Output: ESM `.mjs` + `.d.ts`. Vanilla Extract for CSS-in-TS (zero runtime).

## Static / Edit Split (Core Architecture)

The ecosystem splits **nodes** and **renderers** into static (read-only) and edit (editor-only) variants for tree-shaking.

- **Static Node/Renderer**: Display-only. No `@haklex/rich-editor-ui` or `lucide-react` imports. Used by `RichRenderer`.
- **Edit Node/Renderer**: Extends static variant. Adds heavy deps (Popover, DropdownMenu, NestedComposer). Used by `RichEditor`.

**Split criteria**: Only split when the edit path introduces heavy imports absent from the static path.

Registration:

- `@haklex/rich-editor` `src/config.ts` → static nodes → `RichRenderer`
- `@haklex/rich-editor` `src/config-edit.ts` → edit nodes → `RichEditor`
- `@haklex/rich-renderers` `src/config.ts` → `enhancedRendererConfig` (static renderers)
- `@haklex/rich-renderers-edit` `src/config.ts` → `enhancedEditRendererConfig` (edit renderers)

**Adding a new node with edit UI**: Create `FooNode` with `RendererWrapper` in `decorate()`, then `FooEditNode extends FooNode` overriding `decorate()` with edit decorator. Register base in `config.ts`, edit in `config-edit.ts`. Create `FooRenderer` (static) + `FooEditRenderer` (edit). Add to respective aggregator configs.

## Package Dependency Graph

\```
@haklex/rich-kit-shiro (integration bundle — ShiroEditor / ShiroRenderer)
├── @haklex/rich-editor (core: nodes + plugins + styles + contexts)
│ ├── @haklex/rich-editor-ui (Dialog, Dropdown, Popover via @base-ui/react)
│ ├── @haklex/rich-headless (server-side node registry, zero React)
│ └── @haklex/rich-style-token (theme tokens, CSS variables, variant presets)
├── @haklex/rich-static-renderer (SSR engine, RichRenderer component)
├── @haklex/rich-renderers (static renderer aggregator)
├── @haklex/rich-renderers-edit (edit renderer aggregator)
├── @haklex/rich-ext-{code-snippet,embed,excalidraw,gallery} (heavy extensions)
├── @haklex/rich-plugin-{block-handle,floating-toolbar,link-edit,mention,slash-menu,table,toolbar}
└── @haklex/rich-renderer-katex (KaTeX edit nodes)

@haklex/rich-diff (standalone diff viewer)
@haklex/rich-editor-demo (dev playground)
\```

## Key Conventions

- **Context Provider value stability**: Never pass object literals as context `value`. Primitives OK directly; objects must be `useMemo`'d.
- **Neutral colors**: Use `#737373` / `#a3a3a3` (neutral-500/400) for muted text/borders. No tinted grays (slate, zinc).
- **Styling**: Vanilla Extract (`*.css.ts`) throughout. No Tailwind in editor packages.
- **Variant system**: `article` (sans-serif, 16px), `note` (CJK serif, 16px), `comment` (sans-serif, 14px). Controlled by `variant` prop + `ColorSchemeContext`.

## Downstream Consumers

\```
Shiroi (Next.js frontend, ../Shiroi)
└── @haklex/rich-kit-shiro (workspace link, native React)
haklex/ lives inside Shiroi/ as workspace member. This repo is the extracted standalone version.

admin-vue3 (Vue 3 dashboard, ../admin-vue3)
└── @haklex/{rich-editor,rich-editor-ui,rich-kit-shiro,rich-plugin-toolbar,rich-style-token,rich-diff,rich-ext-nested-doc}
React-in-Vue bridge: createRoot() inside Vue defineComponent (src/components/editor/rich/RichEditor.tsx)

mx-core (NestJS backend, ../mx-core)
└── @haklex/rich-headless
Server-side: createHeadlessEditor() + allHeadlessNodes + $toMarkdown() for Lexical JSON → Markdown
\```

**Release flow**: `pnpm release:rich` → bump + build + publish to npm. Then update pinned versions in `admin-vue3/package.json` and `mx-core/apps/core/package.json`.
````

Release @haklex/\* packages and update all downstream consumers.

## Steps

### 1. Pre-flight checks

Run `git status` in haklex repo. Ensure working tree is clean or all changes are committed. If not, stop and ask the user.

### 2. Version bump

Run `pnpm release` interactively in `<HOME>/git/repos/haklex`. This bumps all `@haklex/*` package versions via bumpp. The user will choose the version in the terminal.

After bumpp completes, read the new version from `packages/rich-editor/package.json` → `version` field. Store as `$NEW_VERSION`.

### 3. Build & Publish

\```bash
cd <HOME>/git/repos/haklex && pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r publish --no-git-checks --filter '@haklex/\*' --filter '!@haklex/rich-editor-demo'
\```

If publish fails, stop and report.

### 4. Commit the version bump in haklex

Stage and commit all changed `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml` files:
\```
release: v$NEW_VERSION
\```

### 5. Update downstream projects

For each downstream project, update all `@haklex/*` dependency versions to `$NEW_VERSION`:

**Shiroi** — `<HOME>/git/repos/Shiroi/apps/web/package.json`

- Update `@haklex/rich-editor`, `@haklex/rich-kit-shiro`, `@haklex/rich-static-renderer`

**admin-vue3** — `<HOME>/git/repos/admin-vue3/package.json`

- Update `@haklex/rich-diff`, `@haklex/rich-ext-nested-doc`, `@haklex/rich-editor`, `@haklex/rich-editor-ui`, `@haklex/rich-kit-shiro`, `@haklex/rich-plugin-toolbar`, `@haklex/rich-style-token`

**mx-core** — `<HOME>/git/repos/mx-core/apps/core/package.json`

- Update `@haklex/rich-headless`

Use sed or Edit to replace pinned version strings. Match pattern: `"@haklex/<pkg>": "<old_version>"` → `"@haklex/<pkg>": "$NEW_VERSION"`.

### 6. Install in downstream projects

Run `pnpm install` in each downstream project root:
\```bash
cd <HOME>/git/repos/Shiroi && pnpm install
cd <HOME>/git/repos/admin-vue3 && pnpm install
cd <HOME>/git/repos/mx-core && pnpm install
\```

### 7. Check for new features to integrate

Compare the haklex git log since the previous version tag to identify new exports, new packages, or breaking changes:
\```bash
cd <HOME>/git/repos/haklex && git log --oneline HEAD~20..HEAD
\```

Scan for:

- New package exports (new entry points in `package.json` exports)
- New renderer/plugin/extension packages that downstream projects might want
- Breaking changes (renamed exports, removed APIs)

If new features are found, ask the user whether to integrate them into specific downstream projects. Do NOT auto-integrate without confirmation.

### 8. Commit in downstream projects

For each downstream project with changes, stage and commit:
\```
chore(deps): bump @haklex/\* to $NEW_VERSION
\```

### 9. Summary

Print a table:
| Project | Version | Packages Updated | New Features |
